controls.name: transfer_to_larger_uncertainty
controls.predicate: The destination radius must not exceed the radius whose domains were proved.

controls.name: round_away_outward_radius_increase
controls.predicate: Exact rational order rejects an outward increase of 1e-21 even when both radii have the same binary64 value.

controls.name: negative_noise_radius
controls.predicate: The physical uncertainty contract requires a nonnegative radius.

controls.name: drop_root_population_member
controls.predicate: Every inherited root index must be represented in the containment proof.

controls.name: swap_root_correspondence
controls.predicate: Intervals must correspond to the same original root index.

controls.name: change_original_spectral_center
controls.predicate: Containment endpoints are reconstructed from the fixed source intervals, not just from recorded margins.

controls.name: extend_inner_endpoint_beyond_seed
controls.predicate: Both sides of every inner interval must stay within the original wider interval.

controls.name: borrow_other_observation_domains
controls.predicate: The inherited domains must belong to the same observation and local profile.

controls.name: borrow_smaller_radius_singletons
controls.predicate: A narrower-radius success cannot seed this wider-radius calculation.

controls.name: replace_seed_by_future_domains
controls.predicate: Initial coefficient domains must exactly match the previously validated seed, before this pass makes deductions.

reverse_transfer_counterexample.scope: A universal predicate on the smaller box fails at this permitted point of the larger box. This disproves unrestricted reverse certificate transfer; it is not an alternate-field or spectral-realizability witness.

rounded_radius_counterexample.scope: This is the same exact-order mutation counted above, presented as an explicit endpoint witness; it is not an additional independent experiment.

scope: Ten actual mutations test the new premise-transfer contract. Exact endpoint witnesses expose reverse-direction and binary64-order errors. The four Lean theorems concern box geometry and predicate transport, not the full arithmetic or numerical proof.
